questions.stem_text: The theory of evolution is most accurately described as

options.A: a universally accepted fact about the origin and development of all species.
options.B: a hypothesis in the process of being tested and verified.
options.C: a disproven theory about the development of species over time.
options.D: a speculation about possible changes in populations over time.
options.E: an opinion that some scientists hold about how living things change over time.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - a universally accepted fact about the origin and development of all species.

questions.stem_text:
Why is genetic drift less important in human evolution at present than it was twenty
thousand or more years ago?

options.A: The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures
options.B: Modern medicine has eliminated the effects of genetic drift
options.C: The rate of genetic drift is directly proportional to technological advancements
options.D: Humans have reached a genetic equilibrium where drift is no longer possible
options.E: Humans have developed immunity to genetic drift

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures

questions.stem_text:
A male bacterium conjugates with a female bacterium. After conjugation, the female becomes
a male. Account for this "sexchange".

options.A: The female bacterium becomes a male as a result of nutrient deficiency
options.B: The female becomes a male by receiving one copy of the F factor
options.C: The female bacterium becomes a male through the process of osmosis
options.D: The female bacterium becomes a male through gene mutation
options.E: The female bacterium becomes a male after receiving multiple copies of non-F factor genes

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The female becomes a male by receiving one copy of the F factor
